uncited: The method approximates the perspective viewing frustum as a sequence of parallel slabs.
The core inputs are the volume dataset, the camera position, and the view direction.
**Slab Decomposition**: The volume is divided into slabs perpendicular to the view direction.
**Compositing**: The results from the parallel projected slabs are composited together.
The approximation error is bounded by adjusting the slab boundaries based on the analytical error model.
The exact time and memory complexity are not given in the sources.
